title: Positive density forces membership in the support (general fact G2)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), y ∈ U and θ ∈ ℝ with θ > 0. If Θ^n(μ_T, y) = θ in the sense HasMassDensity T y θ (θ ≥ 0 and M_{B_t(y)}(T)/(ω_n t^n) → θ in [0, ∞] as t ↓ 0, ω_n = unitBallVolume n), then y ∈ spt T.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), y ∈ U → 0 < θ → HasMassDensity T y θ → y ∈ T.support
